user.title: Add a site
user.description: The site shows as a page in the sidebar. For a site that blocks frames, or an HTTP site on an HTTPS Home Assistant, add it to the Sidebar Proxy add-on and use proxy://Site-Name (the site name with dashes instead of spaces).

error.invalid_url: The address must start with http:// or https://, or be proxy://Site-Name (for the Sidebar Proxy add-on).
error.duplicate_name: A site with this name already exists.
